disclosures.text: A control assembly for manipulating movement of an endoscopic instrument
An endoscopic instrument mounting arrangement adapted to receive the endoscopic instrument
The mounting arrangement has three independent degrees of freedom of movement for the endoscopic instrument
Each degree of freedom of movement is about or along a respective axis
Three driving arrangements
Each driving arrangement is configured to drive the endoscopic instrument in only one degree of freedom of movement
Three independent control elements configured to receive user input
Actuation of each control element regulates one of three corresponding control signals
Each control signal controls a respective one of the driving arrangements
Each control signal controls its respective driving arrangement independent from the other two driving arrangements
Control is in accordance with user input

A method of manufacturing a control assembly for manipulating movement of an endoscopic instrument, comprising: providing an endoscopic instrument mounting arrangement with three independent degrees of freedom of movement, each about or alo
The endoscopic instrument is an endoscope
The mounting arrangement comprises a curved track rotatable about a rotation axis with respect to a support structure
The curved track has a center of curvature along the rotation axis
An endoscopic instrument mount receives the endoscopic instrument and is moveable along the curved track
The instrument is moved in a radial direction with respect to the curved track
At least one control element comprises one or more relays adapted to receive the respective control signal and actuate one of the driving arrangements
A user operated control unit adapted to house the control elements
The three degrees of freedom of movement are substantially confocal in free space around a fixed point
Each driving assembly operates with only one degree of freedom
